settings.examModeNote: New lessons come with six practice items and an exam tip, until you turn this off.
settings.selfAdvance: Move up a level each school year
settings.selfAdvanceNote: Off by default. When a new school year opens in June, your plans start a level higher. What you've mastered stays mastered.
settings.deleteAllDataDevice: Delete all your data on this device?
settings.deleteAccountBlurb: Permanently deletes your account, classes you own, and all server data, then clears this device.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm: Delete your account and all data? This can't be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Try again, or come back when you're online.
settings.teacherSeesAssigned: Your teacher sees your scores on the quizzes and exams they send, and your progress in their class's subject. Your other subjects, practice answers and roots stay private.
settings.aiText: Lessons, hints and reading photos of your work: GLM 5.3 Flash on Together or Baseten (US). Only your math is sent, never your name.
settings.aiVoice: Voice input, only if you turn it on: speech recognition on your device writes it down; the transcript goes to the text model above when you're online, and is typed on-device when you're not. 18+ only.

help.title: Help
help.heading: Show me the question

help.privacy: Only the question and your answer are sent, never your name. Leave names out of the question too.

check.intro: About 10 quick questions. No grades, no pressure: it just shows Hopper where to start, and stops early once that's clear.

check.gapTextSome: You handled parts of Grade {grade}, but missed a foundation from Grade {from}. Fixing it first makes the rest click.
check.goingBack: Let's look a little further back…
